meta.title: Switch the QCS between vertical and horizontal view
gaps: Directly assert that the QCS grid's visual orientation changed from vertical to horizontal and back.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly assert that the QCS grid's visual orientation changed from vertical to horizontal and back.

steps.note: Open the prepared QCS containing vendor quotations.
Record that the QCS rendered real vendor columns before changing the layout.
Verify the initial vendor quotation data is present.
Switch the QCS to the alternate horizontal layout.
Verify the same vendor data remains visible after the first toggle.
Verify the quotation value is retained after the first layout change.
Toggle the QCS layout back to the original orientation.
Verify the same vendor data remains visible after toggling back.
Verify the quotation value is still retained after the second toggle.
